description: Update a single conversation (conversationStatus: ACTIVE, ARCHIVE, DELETE; or read flag).

conversationId.description: The unique identifier of the conversation

conversationStatus.description: The updated status: ACTIVE, ARCHIVE, DELETE

conversationType.description: The existing type: FROM_MEMBERS or FROM_EBAY (required but cannot be updated)

read.description: The read status to set (true = read, false = unread)

name: ebay_update_conversation
